memories.title: Public API backward compatibility policy
memories.body: Keep the public API backward compatible for the next two releases. Breaking changes are prohibited during this window because deployed clients update on a quarterly schedule, and early breaks would strand them.
memories.why: Client update schedules are outside our control; breaking the API early strands clients who cannot immediately upgrade.
memories.source_quote: Keep the public API backward compatible for the next two releases. Our deployed clients update quarterly, so breaking the API early would strand those clients.

memories.title: Date format preference for reports
memories.body: Always show dates in YYYY-MM-DD (ISO) format in reports to avoid ambiguity when comparing across regions.

memories.title: Audit records append-only for 7 years
memories.body: Audit records must be append-only and retained for seven years. Rewriting historical audit records is prohibited due to contractual obligations.
memories.why: Contractual audit requirements prohibit rewriting historical records, necessitating an immutable, long-term retention strategy.
